boards.hardware: ESP32-C3, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM; ST7789P3 240x320 SPI LCD; ES8311 codec (mic + speaker); three ADC keys (UP/DOWN/OK); CW2017 fuel gauge
boards.identify: Wearable badge with a 240x320 colour screen and three physical keys; USB-C (ESP32-C3 native USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO18/19)
boards.flash_port: USB-C (native USB Serial/JTAG). Download mode: hold the OK/BOOT-side key path if needed, or use esptool auto-reset.
boards.use: Push-to-talk with the agent through the Deotaland App over BLE: hold OK to speak, release to send; replies play on the speaker; screen colour shows link status
boards.notes: ESP32-C3 profile: ai-passport-ble; build with tools/build_firmware.py. Uses partitions_esp32c3.csv (8 MB, dual OTA). Console is USB Serial/JTAG — UART0 TX conflicts with the backlight (GPIO21). Pins match FoloToy ai-passport bsp_pins.h.
